scope: Explicit createProcess integration in the actual product host loop and independently installed compiled JS product. verified: createProcess is called once after configuration preflight. The native factory transfers process server components separately from each device adapter, rejects invalid process authorization before device acquisition, and rejects device adapters returning a second server owner.

The actual runProductHost selects process server lifetime, reuses its listener with fresh printer bindings, and preserves one native JWT authorization database, identified WebSocket and published file lock through three generations. Each prior simulated physical stop runs once.

Database maintenance uses the fresh generation gate; file downloading works after each source attachment. Compiled catalog, metadata and thumbnail paths work after reinitialization. The device-offline window is not continuously available.

The final host shutdown retires device/profile first, then closes its server and factory. The three-generation test counts exactly one database close and one process release. Startup cancellation waits for a late adapter and releases device before process resources; final storage locks reopen.

Accepted HTTP recovery on replacement configuration failure or physical-stop failure records a durable failed receipt. The same authorized server remains listening and reports not-ready/stopped or not-ready/failed until explicit process shutdown. No automatic retry or print replay.

The separately rebuilt, independently installed compiled product exports/forwards the factory lifetime. Native JWT and original notification sockets survive reinitialization at the same address; the existing complete heated-print, pause/resume, cancel, history, thumbnail, recovery and ADC fault flow passes under concurrent API/upload load.
The compiled trace confirms one process resource open and close, generation release precedes replacement, and process close follows final profile release.
